_comment: Real content as of 2026-08-13 — see Engineering-Log.md. puzzleClue is intentionally identical across units (same physical switch mechanic on every build). puzzleLinkUrl is intentionally BLANK per unit — each groomsman gets a different destination, and only Skyler knows them. To fill one in: paste the URL between the quotes on that unit's puzzleLinkUrl line below, save, redeploy (see README.md). 'serial' must match that unit's firmware Personalization::SERIAL_NUMBER (config.h) exactly, since it's what's physically printed/shown on the device itself — LPE-GM-00N stays as the internal URL routing key only (?unit=...), it is never shown on screen. Units 002/003 need their real serial filled in once chosen/flashed.

LPE-GM-001.name: JAKE
objectives: Report for duty on 10.20.2028 — full mission briefing at check-in.
Secure the groom's suit, rings, and general composure. In that order.
Deliver the best man speech. Keep it under control; keep it real.
Stand beside Skyler at the altar. This is the actual mission.
LPE-GM-001.hiddenMessage: SERVICE LOG — This unit was custom-built by Skyler for one reason: you've always shown up when it counted. Every objective on this screen is real — 10.20.2028, for real. Thanks for saying yes to standing up there with me. — Skyler
LPE-GM-001.puzzleClue:
◈ INTERCEPT — SRC UNKNOWN — 74% RECOVERED ◈

"...begin at the end, not the start. the last one speaks true first, alone — the ones beside it stay silent, stay wrong, whatever they're told to say. only after the last has proven itself does the first get its turn. whichever one sits between them was never listening. it says nothing. it will never say anything..."

◈ SIGNAL LOST ◈
